question: How many weeks of paid parental leave does GitLab provide?
expected_answer: GitLab provides 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

passages.text: GitLab provides 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave

question: Can parental leave be split into separate periods?
expected_answer: Yes. It can be taken all at once or split into up to three segments.

passages.text: You may take your Parental Leave all at once or split it into up to three segments.

question: What percentage of weekly wages are paid during parental leave?
expected_answer: Eligible team members receive 100% of weekly wages.

passages.text: Eligible team members will receive 100% of their weekly wages through the GitLab Paid Parental Leave.

question: Which team should someone contact with questions before parental leave starts?
expected_answer: Contact the Absence Management team at leaves@gitlab.com.

passages.text: If you have questions before your leave begins, please contact leaves@gitlab.com.

question: By when should proof of birth or adoption be provided?
expected_answer: Within 15 calendar days from the start of leave.

passages.text: proof of birth/relationship and/or adoption within 15 calendar days from the start of your leave.

question: Does GitLab set a fixed annual limit on how many PTO days someone can take?
expected_answer: No specific annual limit is set, but more than 25 consecutive calendar days needs special permission.

passages.text: GitLab does not set a specific limit on the amount of PTO a team member can take per year.

question: How much advance notice should I give my manager for planned PTO?
expected_answer: At least twice as many days of notice as the planned time off.

passages.text: Discuss planned time off with your manager first and provide as much notice as possible, but at least twice as many days as your planned time off (e.g., 6 business days notice for 3 days off).

question: Where can I enter PTO?
expected_answer: In the Workday app or through the Workday Slack integration.

passages.text: You can enter PTO directly into the Workday app, or through the Workday Slack integration.

question: Do unused public holiday days carry over into the next calendar year?
expected_answer: No, unused public holiday balances do not roll over.

passages.text: unused public holiday balances will **not** rollover to the following calendar year.

question: How are public holidays handled for eligible GitLab GSI contractors?
expected_answer: GitLab provides a standardized allocation of 12 public holidays.

passages.text: GitLab has chosen to provide a standardized allocation of 12 public holidays

question: How many paid caregiver sick days can a team member use?
expected_answer: Up to 25 paid caregiver sick days, available from the first day of work.

passages.text: Each GitLab team member may use up to 25 paid caregiver sick days, available from their first day of work.

question: Which family members are eligible for caregiver sick time?
expected_answer: Parents, children, spouses, domestic partners, grandparents, grandchildren, and siblings.

passages.text: Eligible family members include parent(s), child(ren), spouse, domestic partner, grandparent(s), grandchild(ren), or sibling(s).

question: When does caregiver sick absence become a leave of absence?
expected_answer: At six or more consecutive days.

passages.text: Caregiver sick absences that are 6 days or longer are considered a **leave of absence**.

question: When does bereavement leave become available to a new team member?
expected_answer: From the first day of work.

passages.text: Bereavement leave at GitLab falls under our Flexible PTO framework, allowing team members to take the time they need when faced with a loss. This benefit is available to all team members on their first day of work.

question: Does bereavement leave cover the loss of a pet?
expected_answer: Yes. The policy includes loss of pets.

passages.text: This includes loss of pregnancy (birthing and non-birthing parents), family members, friends, colleagues, and pets.

question: Does GitLab require proof of loss to request bereavement leave?
expected_answer: No, unless local or statutory law requires it.

passages.text: We do not require documentation or proof of loss to access bereavement leave (unless required by local/statutory law).

question: What pay does the handbook specify for bereavement leave?
expected_answer: 100% of weekly wages.

passages.text: Team members receive 100% of their weekly wages during bereavement leave

question: What happens to a team member's job, pay, and benefits during military leave of 31 days or less?
expected_answer: No changes are made, and they can return to their next working shift after service.

passages.text: No changes will be made to the team member’s job, pay, or benefits and team members will be eligible to return to their next working shift after their military service ends.

question: How much unpaid military leave may be available for active duty lasting more than 31 days?
expected_answer: Up to six months, subject to statutory entitlement and business needs.

passages.text: Team members reporting for active duty of more than 31 days may be eligible for up to 6 months of unpaid leave.

question: When is stock vesting paused during leave?
expected_answer: After six months of continuous leave; it resumes on the first day back at work.

passages.text: Stock vesting is paused after six months of continuous leave and resumes on your first day back at work.

question: If I'm becoming a parent, how long can I be away and still receive GitLab parental pay?
expected_answer: The policy provides 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

passages.text: GitLab provides 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave

question: Can I take bonding leave in several blocks instead of one continuous absence?
expected_answer: Yes, parental leave may be split into up to three segments.

passages.text: You may take your Parental Leave all at once or split it into up to three segments.

question: Do I need to have worked at GitLab for a while before becoming eligible for parental leave?
expected_answer: No. It is available from the first day of employment if the child arrives during employment.

passages.text: This benefit is available from your first day of employment

question: If my state pays part of my parental leave, can the combined payments exceed my normal wages?
expected_answer: No. GitLab supplements statutory pay to 100%, but combined pay will not exceed 100% of weekly wages.

passages.text: You will not receive more than 100% of your wages with statutory leave and Parental Leave combined.

question: For a three-day vacation, what's the minimum lead time I should give my manager?
expected_answer: At least six business days' notice, using twice as many notice days as PTO days requested.

passages.text: When requesting planned time off (i.e. PTO, Public Holidays, Volunteer time), **provide at least twice as many days of advance notice as the duration of your planned absence**. For example, a 3-day absence requires at least 6 business days of advance notice.

question: Are public holidays automatically assigned to everyone's Workday calendar?
expected_answer: No. Team members choose which eligible dates to observe within their balance.

passages.text: public holidays will **not** be pre-loaded to Workday, instead team members have the flexibility to elect different dates

question: At what point should a regular sick absence be treated as a leave of absence?
expected_answer: When it lasts six days or longer.

passages.text: Sick absences that are 6 days or longer are considered a leave of absence.

question: If I keep my medical details private, what will my manager be told?
expected_answer: Only essential information about the leave dates is shared on a need-to-know basis.

passages.text: on a need-to-know basis, providing only essential information related to leave dates.

question: Can a remote employee set their schedule around the hours when they work best?
expected_answer: Yes. The handbook lists choosing working hours based on when someone is most productive as a remote-work benefit.

passages.text: You can [choose your working hours](/handbook/company/culture/all-remote/) based on when you're [most productive](/handbook/communication/#asynchronous-communication).

question: How long can a digital nomad work temporarily from another country without filing a long-term relocation request?
expected_answer: Up to 183 days, while still meeting the primary-location requirement and other rules.

passages.text: Digital Nomad team members are permitted to reside and work from any country [with considerations](/handbook/people-group/relocation/#considerations-for-short-term-travel) for a maximum of 183 days (approximately 6 months) without having to complete a long term relocation request.

question: Can I move first and ask for approval after I arrive?
expected_answer: No. Relocation approval must be requested before moving.

passages.text: All Team Members are required to request an approval to relocate prior to moving.

question: Does bereavement time have to be taken as one uninterrupted block?
expected_answer: No. It can be taken continuously or intermittently.

passages.text: You can take bereavement continuously or intermittently.

question: Compare parental leave and flexible PTO: what is the stated parental-leave duration, and is PTO capped at a fixed number of days per year?

question: If parental leave overlaps with the scheduled Family and Friends Days, what extension applies, and do unused public holiday balances roll over?
expected_answer: Parental leave is extended by four days; unused public holiday balances do not roll over to the next year.

unused public holiday balances will **not** rollover to the following calendar year.

question: Compare emergency leave and bereavement leave: how should someone notify the company, and where can each request be recorded?
expected_answer: For emergency leave, notify the manager as soon as possible and enter dates in Workday; for bereavement, notify the manager when able and enter dates in Workday.

You should notify your manager as soon as you're able and enter dates in Workday when you can.

question: Compare voluntary short-term travel with business travel: is voluntary travel covered by the Business Accident Travel Policy, and is company business-trip coverage automatic?
